scientific_integrity: Source shift and preservation of absolute Cesaro boundedness are recognized as prior work; novel scope is the simultaneous fractional-Gaussian sharp asymptotic of powers and their first difference.
scientific_limitations: Exact sharp asymptotics for a specified positive lazy-shift family on complex ell^1, with fixed interior parameters; no positive-operator assertion on L^p for p>1 and no endpoint or universality claim. Numerical checks cannot prove the operator-norm limits. Priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Gaussian sharp constants for lazy positive weighted shifts
